description: Convert the text of a text frame into paths (in Pfade umwandeln) – a headline as a graphic, independent of installed fonts. Irreversible: there is no undo through this interface; confirm true is required. delete_original true (default) replaces the frame with the outlines; false keeps the text frame and puts the outlines on top of it. Refused (invalid_state): empty frames, threaded frames (the story runs over more than one frame), frames with overset text, frames on locked layers. Tables inside the frame give a warning – check the result. Returns frame_id of the new object, type (group or polygon), member_count, bounds_mm, page_id, page_name, source_frame_id, source_deleted, characters_converted and fonts_used[] {family, style}; warns that the text is no longer searchable or editable.

confirm.description: Required: true confirms the irreversible conversion.

delete_original.description: Remove the text frame after converting. Default true.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: convert_text_to_outlines
title: Convert text to outlines (irreversible)
